details.purpose: *To record detail about a symptom - either self-recorded by an individual or recorded on the behalf of a patient by a clinician. A complete patient history may include varying level of details about a variety of symptoms.(en)
details.use:
*Use to record detailed information about a symptom as told to a clinician by a patient or self-recorded by the individual/patient.
This archetype allows a 'nil significant' statement to be explicitly recorded.(en)

details.purpose: *To record detail about a symptom - either self-recorded by an individual or recorded on the behalf of a patient by a clinician. A complete patient history may include varying level of details about a variety of symptoms.(en)
details.use:
*Use to record detailed information about a symptom as told to a clinician by a patient or self-recorded by the individual/patient.
This archetype allows a 'nil significant' statement to be explicitly recorded.(en)
details.misuse:
*Not to be used to record details about pain. Use the specialisation of this archetype - the CLUSTER.symptom-pain instead.
Not to be used for diagnoses and problems that form part of a persisting Problem List - use EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.(en)

details.purpose: To record detail about the subjective experience of pain - either self-recorded by an individual or recorded on the behalf of a patient by a clinician.
details.use:
Use to record detailed information about pain as told to a clinician by a patient or self-recorded by the individual/patient.
This archetype allows a 'nil significant' statement to be explicitly recorded.
details.misuse:
Not to be used to record details for symptoms other than pain. Use the generic parent of this archetype - the CLUSTER.symptom instead.
Not to be used for diagnoses and problems that form part of a persisting Problem List - use EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.

details.purpose: Un arquetipo especializado para recoger los síntomas Dolor y la información sobre esos síntomas. Este arquetipo permite realizar una declaración de que el paciente no tiene el síntoma (sin ninguna otra información) o requerir una declaración más detallada. La razón de que se elija entre que una declaración negativa general pueda ser realizada o se permita una declaración más detallada es asegurar de que no hay posibilidad de error con declaraciones negativas sobre el síntoma, mezcladas con detalles de un síntoma que es claramente positivo.
details.use: Para recoger información sobre el(los) dolor(dolores). La información puede ser codificada y estructurada en caso necesario o utiliza la descripción detallada con texto libre del síntoma como descripción clínica si lo requiere.
details.misuse:
*Not to be used to record details for symptoms other than pain. Use the generic parent of this archetype - the CLUSTER.symptom instead.
Not to be used for diagnoses and problems that form part of a persisting Problem List - use EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.(en)
